TGDrive modifications to PDF.js 6.4.299, 26 October 2026

PDF.js is Copyright Mozilla Foundation and contributors, licensed under the
Apache License 2.0. The unchanged license accompanies this notice in
pdfjs-LICENSE.txt. Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

TGDrive modifies build/pdf.worker.mjs to defer shared PDF image streams until
the corresponding image is painted. Required masks and color resources load
before decoding, after image dimension and configured image-size rejection.
This preserves selective range loading for PDFs with shared page resources.

The reviewed modified package is shipped in website/vendor. The maintenance
command scripts/vendor_viewers.py verifies the exact upstream archive and applies
website/scripts/patch-pdf-worker.js. Normal builds do not rewrite dependencies.
The original licenses and rendering-resource notices are retained. Local CMaps,
standard fonts, ICC profiles and decoder WASM are served with their notices.
